thread:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — just finished a call with NorthBay. They handed over a small set of feature asks + two blockers causing onboarding delays. TL;DR: "embed refresh rate" and unclear per-route billing UI.
Arjun (Product): Thanks Maya — can you paste the raw asks here? quick bullets are fine.
Maya (CS): sure, copying notes: 1) auto-refresh embeddings when model version pins change (they re-run offline and expect near-real-time in app) 2) per-route toggle for billing visibility — finance team needs a simple on/off for customers 3) request: admin UI to view customer-specific token usage by route (they said current CSV export is painful)
Evan (PM): Those map to product signals we've seen. Prioritization ask: which of these is causing renewal risk vs just a convenience? Maya (CS): embedding refresh and billing toggle = renewal risk (NorthBay is about to close bulk pilot renewal). Token CSV = low risk but high annoyance.
Priya (CS): Adding color: Customer tried the manual refresh workaround and hit race conditions — they reported duplicated vectors and stale results for 4 hours. That broke two demos.
Ben (Eng): Can you paste the exact steps that reproduce the duplication? That'll help estimate effort.
Maya (CS): Steps from call: 1) they upload new embeddings -> 2) background job triggers re-index -> 3) UI triggers a downstream fetch while KV update still streaming -> duplication shows. They can reproduce reliably.
Arjun (Product): Proposed next steps: (A) Quick mitigation: add a debounce + UI status until indexing finished (low effort) (B) Mid-term: server-side atomic swap for namespace updates (medium effort) (C) Billing toggle: add per-tenant feature flag in Console + API (small effort). Thoughts?
Evan (PM): Let's treat embed refresh as P1 for NorthBay pilot renewal. Billing toggle P1 for finance visibility too. CSV token export UX -> backlog P2.
Priya (CS): Can we ship a temporary doc for customers describing the manual steps + known race? They'll ask for timelines. I'll draft.
Maya (CS): I can paste a proposed customer note in a minute.
feedback-bot: Note created: https://redwood.internal/notes/CS-4532109876 — assigned to @Arjun (Product).
Arjun (Product): Thanks. @Ben, can you give a rough engineering estimate for (A) debounce + UI status and (B) atomic swap? Ballpark hours is fine.
Ben (Eng): (A) debounce + status: ~16-24h including tests and deploy. (B) atomic swap server-side: ~3-4w depending on infra changes. Billing toggle: ~2-3d to add flag + console UI.
Evan (PM): Good. Plan: ship (A) + billing toggle as a quick patch two-week cycle, communicate to NorthBay, and scope atomic swap for Q3. Maya/Priya please coordinate comms.
Maya (CS): Will do — I'll send an email template + in-product note.
Priya (CS): I'll schedule a short call with NorthBay to demo the patch.
Arjun (Product): I'll open a quick RFC in the repo describing the atomic swap plan and link this thread.
Maya (CS): Customer asked about prioritization criteria — they want transparency on roadmap impact. Can we include a one-paragraph explainer in the doc?
Evan (PM): Yes — include criteria: user impact (renewal/blocker), engineering effort, security/regulatory needs, cross-customer demand. Keep it short.
Maya (CS): Drafted msg for NorthBay (copy): "We're prioritizing fixes that directly block your pilot renewal (embed refresh + billing visibility). We'll push a UI status + debounce patch within 10 business days and a billing toggle within two weeks. We'll keep you updated on the atomic swap timeline for long-term consistency." Thoughts?
Arjun (Product): Sounds good. Add a sentence offering a short follow-up demo once patch is live.
Maya (CS): Added. Sending now.
Evan (PM): Closing loop: @Ben please add the ticket numbers here once created. Also tag eng-oncall if deploy touches indexing pipelines.
Ben (Eng): Will do. Thanks all.
Maya (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup:
